snippet.title: Discover Mew! | Pokémon Sleep
snippet.description:
Reports of the Mythical Pokémon Mew have been recorded in many areas. Research shows that this ever-curious Pokémon has been flying around sleeping Pokémon! 

📸 Mew may show up in photos when you research sleep styles. Collect Snapshot Surprise photos with Mew and progress through Snapshot Surprise missions to conduct more detailed research. 

To celebrate Pokémon Day today, receive 1,000 diamonds 💎 and 10 Poké Biscuits! 🍪

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
